How to beat Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation七星剑阵 (preview coverage)

This is a seven-puppet fight: one main puppet plus six minor ones. Focus damage on the main puppet, since the minor puppets have lots of health, and their hits are weak. Dodge or perfect parry the synchronized unblockable attack to trigger a Ghoststep counter. In phase 2, run perpendicular to the homing string swarm and watch for red-glowing strings before the ranged attack. Recommended: Soft Snake Sword (its block stops all incoming projectiles; Game8 calls it a panic button)..

How to beat Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation
This is a seven-puppet fight: one main puppet plus six minor ones. Focus damage on the main puppet, since the minor puppets have lots of health, and their hits are weak. Dodge or perfect parry the synchronized unblockable attack to trigger a Ghoststep counter. In phase 2, run perpendicular to the homing string swarm and watch for red-glowing strings before the ranged attack.
Put most of your damage into the main puppet; the six minor puppets have a lot of health and their hits are weak. Dodge or perfectly parry the synced attacks to trigger a Ghoststep counter. If Red joins, kill her first: her Sha-Chi regenerates quickly, so go for counterattacks right after parrying her instead of guard breaks. Red and the boss often attack together, so let the full combo play out and time a perfect parry at the end. Keep track of the boss while you fight Red.
Phases
Two phases. Phase 2 adds homing puppet strings, an unblockable ranged attack and a projectile barrage. If you left Red alive earlier, she joins when his health drops below 50% and heals him at the cost of her own life.
How to get there
Go to the Three Towers bell in Mandate Encampment and take the ladder; the boss is directly below it.
Attacks to watch for
Jump Pad: puppets form a sword ramp and the boss does a jumping slash; parryable.
Staircase: puppets form a staircase and the boss dashes at you; parryable.
Synced Strike: six puppets attack together, unblockable and potentially lethal; dodge or perfectly parry.
Phase 2 homing puppet-string swarm: sprint perpendicular to the boss; if caught, dodge through the tail end.
Phase 2 ranged unblockable attack: strings glow red first; dodge for a Ghoststep counter.
Phase 2 melee attacks have bouncy, weighty timing that is easy to block.
Dash from above the stage then blue attack: parry the blue attack.
Three-swing attack: the third swing is blue; parry it.
Phase 2 air barrage of many small red projectiles: keep dodging, since each one deals damage and they can kill in seconds.
Phase 2 projectile barrage after he leaves your sight for a few seconds: stop chasing Red and find him.
Weak points
Perfect parries and dodges against his synced and ranged attacks trigger Ghoststep counters. Red's Sha-Chi regenerates fast, so guard-break attempts on her are ineffective.
Recommended weapon
Soft Snake Sword (its block stops all incoming projectiles; Game8 calls it a panic button). — compare options in the weapons list.
Before the fight
Rest at the nearest bell first. It refills your health and items and becomes your respawn point. See how saving works.
Spend your upgrade materials before the fight. A reforge refunds them later, so you lose nothing by trying a different weapon. See how to upgrade weapons.
Stuck? Drop the difficulty for one attempt and raise it again afterwards. You can change it at any time.
Rewards
Swordsman's Summon; Training Grounds Key
